contracts.name: TelegramConversationMetricRecord
TelegramOperationalEvent
contracts.source:
class TelegramOperationalEvent:
    name: str
    level: str
    component: str
    outcome: str
    fields: Mapping[str, object] = field(
        default_factory=dict
    )

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        name = str(
            self.name
        ).strip()

        if not name:
            raise ValueError(
                "name não pode ser vazio."
            )

        if not name.startswith(
            "telegram_"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Eventos Telegram devem começar com telegram_."
            )

        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "name",
            name,
        )

        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "level",
            _validate_choice(
                field_name="level",
                value=self.level,
                allowed=ALLOWED_EVENT_LEVELS,
            ),
        )

        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "component",
            _validate_choice(
                field_name="component",
                value=self.component,
                allowed=ALLOWED_METRIC_COMPONENTS,
            ),
        )

        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "outcome",
            _validate_choice(
                field_name="outcome",
                value=self.outcome,
                allowed=ALLOWED_OUTCOMES,
            ),
        )

        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "fields",
            MappingProxyType(
                dict(self.fields)
            ),
        )
